fidelityVocabulary.registry_reconstructed_exact_direct_decl: Exact source package declaration reconstructed from a cutoff-selected registry version object.
fidelityVocabulary.registry_reconstructed_cutoff_semver_app: Highest target version satisfying one declared range among current-registry versions timestamped at or before the cutoff. It is an isolated range calculation, not a recorded install result.
fidelityVocabulary.not_available: The target range could not be resolved from registry metadata under the stated method.

prohibitedInterpretations: This artifact is not a package-lock, npm --before execution trace, or reproducible installation result.
Peer, optional, bundled, workspace, override, and nested dependency behavior is not resolved here.
No transitive dependency graph, downstream reach, centrality, blast radius, or attack-return metric is computed.
